title: Chapter 5. Praise of Gaura, the Pastimes of Navadvipa, Separation, and Nityananda in Gauda
html:
Padas of contemporaries which Majumdar (Sri-Chaitanya-chariter upadan, ch. 2) assigns to the Lord's own time, in the order of the lilas: praise of Gaura (Paramananda); a kirtana festival in Advaita's house (Parameshvara Dasa); the Lord's pastimes with Gadadhara and His companions in Navadvipa, which Narahari Chakravarti cites in the Bhakti-ratnakara as the testimony of the eyewitness Vasu Ghosha (the battle of flowers, the game of dice, the water play, the rasa, the spring festival of colours); the Lord's ecstatic moods (Shivananda, Chaitanyadasa); the separation of Navadvipa after the sannyasa (Paramananda, Vasu Ghosha, Chaitanyadasa, Madhava Ghosha); and Nityananda in Gauda (Kanu Thakura). The text follows the Padakalpataru (PK), the Bhakti-ratnakara (BR), the Kshanada-gita-chintamani (KGC) and the Gaura-pada-tarangini (GPT1 — 1st ed., 1903; GPT2 — 2nd ed., 1934); the Bengali original, variants and word-for-word translation are in the full version of the book.

1. Paramananda (Gupta) — "gorā-abatāre yāra nā haila bhakati-sāra…" (PK 2202)

Lila: praise of Gaura — a call to worship the feet of Gorachand, the Purifier of the fallen. In PK the pada stands in the 20th pallava among padas on Gaura's mercy; in GPT, among the mangalacharanas (songs of blessing that open a kirtana). According to Majumdar it is one of the padas signed "Paramananda" which he ascribes to Paramananda Gupta, the Lord's companion in Navadvipa — perhaps a fragment of his lost Gauranga-vijaya. Raga kamoda.1

গোরা-অবতারে যার না হৈল ভকতি-সার
আর তার না দেখি উপায় ।
রবির কিরণে যার আঁখি পরসন্ন নৈল
বিধাতা বঞ্চিত ভেল তায় ॥

gorā-abatāre yāra nā haila bhakati-sāra
āra tāra nā dekhi upāya |
rabira kiraṇe yāra ām̐khi parasanna naila
bidhātā bañcita bhela tāya ||

gora-abatare — in the descent of Gora; yara na haila — in whom there arose no; bhakati-sara — essence of devotion (var. bhakati-rasa — taste of devotion); ara tara na dekhi upaya — I see no other means for him; rabira kirane — in the rays of the sun; yara ankhi parasanna naila — whose eyes did not brighten; bidhata — the Creator; banchita bhela taya — has deprived him

1.1One in whom the essence of devotion did not awaken in the descent of Gora —
for him I see no other means:
one whose eyes did not brighten in the rays of the sun
has been deprived by the Creator.2

ভজ গোরাচাঁদের চরণ ।
এ তিন ভুবনে ভাই দয়ার ঠাকুর নাই
গোরা বড় পতিত-পাবন ॥ ধ্রু ॥

bhaja gorācām̐dera caraṇa |
e tina bhubane bhāi dayāra ṭhākura nāi
gorā baṛa patita-pābana || dhru ||

bhaja — worship; gorachandera charana — the feet of Gorachand; e tina bhubane — in these three worlds; bhai — brother; dayara thakura nai — there is no [such] Lord of mercy; gora bara patita-pabana — Gora is the great purifier of the fallen; (dhru) — refrain

1.2(Refrain) Worship the feet of Gorachand!
In the three worlds, brothers, there is no such Lord of mercy:
Gora is the great Purifier of the fallen.

হেম-জলদ কিয়ে প্রেম-সরোবর
করুণা-সিন্ধু অবতার ।
হেন অবতার পাইয়া যে জন শীতল নহে
কি জানি কেমন মন তার ॥

hema-jalada kiye prema-sarobara
karuṇā-sindhu abatāra |
hena abatāra pāiyā ye jana śītala nahe
ki jāni kemana mana tāra ||

hema-jalada — a golden rain-cloud; kiye — or; prema-sarobara — a lake of prema; karuna-sindhu avatara — the descent, an ocean of mercy; hena avatara paiya — having found such a descent; ye jana shitala nahe — whoever is not cooled; ki jani kemana mana tara — I do not know what kind of heart he has

1.3Is He a golden cloud, or a lake of prema —
the descent, an ocean of mercy!
Whoever, having found such a descent, is not cooled —
I do not know what kind of heart he has.

ভব তরিবারে হরি- নাম-মন্ত্র ভেলা করি
আপনে গৌরাঙ্গ করে পার ।
তবে যে ডুবিয়া মরে কেবা উদ্ধারিবে তারে
পরমানন্দের পরিহার ॥

bhaba taribāre hari- nāma-mantra bhelā kari
āpane gaurāṅga kare pāra |
tabe ye ḍubiyā mare kebā uddhāribe tāre
paramānandera parihāra ||

bhaba taribare — to cross [the ocean of] worldly existence; hari-nama-mantra bhela kari — making the mantra of Hari's name a raft; apane gauranga kare para — Gauranga Himself ferries across; tabe ye dubiya mare — if anyone still drowns; keba uddharibe tare — who will rescue him?; paramanandera parihara — [this is] Paramananda's plea

1.4To cross the ocean of worldly existence, making the mantra of Hari's name a raft,
Gauranga Himself ferries [all] across.
If anyone still drowns and perishes — who will save him?
This is Paramananda's plea.3

Majumdar divides the twelve PK padas signed "Paramananda" into Vrajabuli padas of a later poet of Vrindavana and Bengali padas which he ascribes to Paramananda Gupta — the Lord's companion in whose house Nityananda stayed (CB); he regards PK 2202, 2119, 672 and 1693 as possibly fragments of his lost Gauranga-vijaya-gita, mentioned by Jayananda. The attribution is conjectural (S. Ray assigned these padas to Karnapura, Paramananda Sena). is the sun; whoever stays blind at His rising can be helped by nothing else. Lord brought (CC Adi 3, 7).

2. Paramananda (Gupta) — "paraśa-maṇira sane ki diba tulanā re…" (PK 672)

Lila: praise of Gaura: neither the touchstone, nor the moon, nor the wish-fulfilling tree can be compared with Him — He gave away prema without waiting to be asked. In PK the pada is the gaura-chandrika to the section "rasodgara-anuraga" (Radha recalls Her meeting with Krishna). According to Majumdar — possibly from Paramananda Gupta's Gauranga-vijaya. Raga vibhasa.4

পরশ-মণির সনে কি দিব তুলনা রে
পরশ ছোঁয়াইলে হয় সোণা ।
আমার গৌরাঙ্গের গুণে নাচিয়া গাইয়া রে
রতন হইল কত জনা ॥

paraśa-maṇira sane ki diba tulanā re
paraśa chom̐yāile haya soṇā |
āmāra gaurāṅgera guṇe nāciyā gāiyā re
ratana haila kata janā ||

parasha-manira sane — with the touchstone; ki diba tulana re — what comparison can I give?; parasha chhonyaile — at the touch [of the stone]; haya sona — [iron] becomes gold; amara gaurangera gune — by the qualities of my Gauranga; nachiya gaiya re — dancing and singing; ratana haila kata jana — how many people became jewels!

2.1What can be compared with the touchstone? —
at its touch [iron] turns to gold;
but by the virtues of my Gauranga, dancing and singing,
how many people have become jewels!5

শচীর নন্দন বনমালী ।
এ তিন ভুবনে যার তুলনা দিবার নাই
গোরা মোর পরাণ-পুতলী ॥ ধ্রু ॥

śacīra nandana banamālī |
e tina bhubane yāra tulanā dibāra nāi
gorā mora parāṇa-putalī || dhru ||

shachira nandana — the son of Shachi; vanamali — wearing a forest garland; e tina bhubane — in the three worlds; yara tulana dibara nai — to whom nothing can be compared; gora mora parana-putali — Gora, the darling (doll) of my life; (dhru) — refrain

2.2(Refrain) The son of Shachi, wearing the forest garland,
He to whom nothing in the three worlds can be compared —
Gora, the darling of my life.6

গৌরাঙ্গ-চাঁদের ছাঁদে ও চাঁদ কলঙ্কী রে
এমন করিতে নারে আলো ।
অকলঙ্ক পূর্ণ-চাঁদ উদয় নদিয়া-পুরে
মনের আন্ধার দূরে গেলো ॥

gaurāṅga-cām̐dera chām̐de o cām̐da kalaṅkī re
emana karite nāre ālo |
akalaṅka pūrṇa-cām̐da udaya nadiyā-pure
manera āndhāra dūre gelo ||

gauranga-chandera chhande — beside the form of the moon Gauranga; o chanda kalanki re — that moon is spotted; emana karite nare alo — cannot give such light; akalanka purna-chanda — the spotless full moon; udaya nadiya-pure — has risen in the town of Nadia; manera andhara dure gelo — the darkness of the heart has gone far away

2.3Beside the form of the moon Gauranga that moon is spotted:
it cannot shine like this.
A spotless full moon has risen in the town of Nadia —
and the darkness of the heart has gone far away.

এ গুণে সুরভি সুর- তরু সম নহে রে
মাগিলে সে পায় কোন জন ।
না মাগিতে অখিল ভুবন ভরি জনে জনে
যাচিয়া দেওল প্রেম-ধন ॥

e guṇe surabhi sura- taru sama nahe re
māgile se pāya kona jana |
nā māgite akhila bhubana bhari jane jane
yāciyā deola prema-dhana ||

e gune — in this quality; surabhi — the Surabhi [cow]; sura-taru — the tree of the gods (wish-fulfilling tree); sama nahe re — are not equal [to Him]; magile — [only] on asking; se paya kona jana — does someone receive; na magite — unasked; akhila bhubana bhari — filling the whole world; jane jane — to each person; yachiya deola prema-dhana — He gave, even entreating, the wealth of prema

2.4In this virtue neither [the cow] Surabhi nor the tree of the gods equals Him:
from them only one who asks receives;
but He, unasked, filled the whole world —
to each person, entreating, He gave the wealth of prema.7

গোরাচাঁদের তুলনা গোরাচাঁদ গোসাঞি রে
বিচার করিয়া দেখ সভে ।
পরমানন্দের মনে এ বড় আকুতি রে
গৌরাঙ্গের দয়া হবে কবে ॥

gorācām̐dera tulanā gorācām̐da gosāñi re
bicāra kariyā dekha sabhe |
paramānandera mane e baṛa ākuti re
gaurāṅgera dayā habe kabe ||

gorachandera tulana — the comparison for Gorachand; gorachanda gosani re — is the Lord Gorachand [Himself]; bichara kariya dekha sabhe — consider and see, all of you; paramanandera mane — in Paramananda's heart; e bara akuti re — this is the great longing; gaurangera daya habe kabe — when will Gauranga's mercy come?

2.5Gorachand can be compared only with the Lord Gorachand Himself —
consider, all of you, and you will see.
In Paramananda's heart there is a great longing:
when will Gauranga's mercy come?

3. Paramananda (Gupta) — "gorā mora dayāra abadhi guṇanidhi…" (PK 2119)

Lila: Navadvipa — Gauranga roams the bank of the Ganga leaning on the shoulders of devotees; He weeps, repeating "Haribol"; His body is covered with thrills, and the earth cannot hold Him. In PK — in the 18th pallava (the form of Sri Gauranga); in KGC — the first pada of the 14th kshanada. According to Majumdar — possibly from Paramananda Gupta's Gauranga-vijaya. Raga shri.8

গোরা মোর দয়ার অবধি গুণনিধি ।
সুরধুনী-তীরে নদীয়া নগরে
গৌরাঙ্গ বিহরে নিরবধি ॥

gorā mora dayāra abadhi guṇanidhi |
suradhunī-tīre nadīyā nagare
gaurāṅga bihare nirabadhi ||

gora mora — my Gora; dayara abadhi — the limit of mercy; gunanidhi — the treasury of virtues; suradhuni-tire — on the bank of the Suradhuni (Ganga); nadiya nagare — in the town of Nadia; gauranga bihare — Gauranga sports (roams); nirabadhi — ceaselessly

3.1My Gora is the limit of mercy, the treasury of virtues:
on the bank of the Suradhuni, in the town of Nadia,
Gauranga sports ceaselessly.

ভুজ-যুগ আরোপিয়া ভকতের কান্ধে ।
চলিতে না পারে গোরা হরিবোল বলিয়া কান্দে ॥

bhuja-yuga āropiyā bhakatera kāndhe |
calite nā pāre gorā haribola baliyā kānde ||

bhuja-yuga aropiya — placing both arms; bhakatera kandhe — on the shoulders of devotees; chalite na pare gora — Gora cannot walk; haribola baliya kande — He weeps, saying "Haribol"

3.2Placing both arms on the shoulders of devotees,
Gora cannot walk — He weeps, repeating "Haribol".

প্রেমে ছল ছল নয়ান-যুগল
কত নদী বহে ধারে ।
পুলকে পূরল সব কলেবর
ধরণী ধরিতে নারে ॥

preme chala chala nayāna-yugala
kata nadī bahe dhāre |
pulake pūrala saba kalebara
dharaṇī dharite nāre ||

preme chhala chhala — brimming with tears of prema; nayana-yugala — the two eyes; kata nadi bahe dhare — how many rivers flow in streams!; pulake purala — filled with thrills; saba kalebara — the whole body; dharani dharite nare — the earth cannot hold [Him]

3.3Both eyes brim with tears of prema —
how many rivers flow in streams!
His whole body is covered with thrills —
the earth cannot hold Him.

সঙ্গে পারিষদ ফিরে নিরন্তর
হরি হরি বোল বলে ।
সখার কান্ধে ভুজ-যুগ দিয়া
হেলিতে দুলিতে চলে ॥

saṅge pāriṣada phire nirantara
hari hari bola bale |
sakhāra kāndhe bhuja-yuga diyā
helite dulite cale ||

sange parishada — the associates with Him; phire nirantara — move about ceaselessly; hari hari bola bale — say "Hari, Hari!"; sakhara kandhe — on His friends' shoulders; bhuja-yuga diya — placing both arms; helite dulite chale — He walks, swaying and rocking

3.4His associates go with Him ceaselessly,
crying, "Hari, Hari!"
Placing both arms on His friends' shoulders,
He walks, swaying and rocking.

ভুবন ভরিয়া প্রেম উভারিল
পতিত-পাবন নাম ।
শুনিয়া ভরসা পরমানন্দের
মনেতে না লয় আন ॥

bhubana bhariyā prema ubhārila
patita-pābana nāma |
śuniyā bharasā paramānandera
manete nā laya āna ||

bhubana bhariya — filling the world; prema ubharila — He poured out prema; patita-pabana nama — [His] name is "Purifier of the fallen"; shuniya — hearing [this]; bharasa paramanandera — Paramananda's hope; manete na laya ana — his heart accepts nothing else

3.5Filling the world, He poured out prema —
His name is "Purifier of the fallen".
Hearing this, Paramananda has taken hope:
his heart accepts nothing else.9

the pada stands immediately before Paramananda's pada "gorā-tanu dhūlāya loṭāya" (PK 2120; chapter 1, no. 7). GPT1 — p. 279, no. 6 (raga shri; the first line is the refrain); GPT2 — twice (sect. 1.3, no. 16; 4.3, no. 6). KGC — 14th kshanada, no. 1 (pp. 106–107; raga dhanashi) — with minor variants: "Gora is the limit of mercy" (without "my"), "Gorachand cannot walk — He weeps, repeating 'Hari, Hari'". Cf. CB Madhya 23 (the Lord with His devotees in kirtana along the bank of the Ganga).

4. Parameshvara Dasa — "eka dina pahum̐ hāsi advaita-mandire āsi…" (PK 23)

Lila: the Lord comes to Advaita's house and with Nityananda and Advaita discusses a great festival; Sita Thakurani speaks sweet words; the Lord orders that all singers and musicians be invited, that a full water-pot, banana trees and garlands be set up, and that in the evening the "khol-mangala" be performed — the blessing of the mridanga before the kirtana. In PK — the first pada of the section "Adhivasa of the sankirtana". According to Majumdar (following S. Ray) — an eyewitness description. Raga dhanashi.10

এক দিন পহুঁ হাসি অদ্বৈত-মন্দিরে আসি
বসিলেন শচীর কুমার ।
নিত্যানন্দ করি সঙ্গে অদ্বৈত বসিয়া রঙ্গে
মহোৎসবের করিলা বিচার ॥

eka dina pahum̐ hāsi advaita-mandire āsi
basilena śacīra kumāra |
nityānanda kari saṅge advaita basiyā raṅge
mahotsabera karilā bicāra ||

eka dina — one day; pahun hasi — the Lord, smiling; advaita-mandire asi — coming to Advaita's house; basilena shachira kumara — the son of Shachi sat down; nityananda kari sange — taking Nityananda with Him; advaita basiya range — Advaita, sitting joyfully; mahotsabera karila bichara — they deliberated on a great festival

4.1One day the Lord, smiling, came to Advaita's house —
and the son of Shachi sat down;
with Nityananda, and with Advaita joyfully seated beside Him,
He deliberated on a great festival.

শুনিয়া আনন্দে হাসি সীতা ঠাকুরাণী আসি
কহিলেন মধুর বচন ।
তা শুনি আনন্দ মনে মহোৎসবের বিধানে
বোলে কিছু শচীর নন্দন ॥

śuniyā ānande hāsi sītā ṭhākurāṇī āsi
kahilena madhura bacana |
tā śuni ānanda mane mahotsabera bidhāne
bole kichu śacīra nandana ||

shuniya — hearing; anande hasi — laughing with joy; sita thakurani asi — Sita Thakurani came; kahilena madhura bachana — she spoke sweet words; ta shuni — hearing that; ananda mane — with a joyful heart; mahotsabera bidhane — about the arrangement of the festival; bole kichhu shachira nandana — the son of Shachi says something

4.2Hearing of this, laughing with joy, Sita Thakurani came
and spoke sweet words.
Hearing them, joyfully, about the arrangement of the festival
the son of Shachi says:

শুন ঠাকুরাণি সীতা বৈষ্ণব আনিয়ে এথা
আমন্ত্রণ করিয়া যতনে ।
যেবা গায় যেবা বায় আমন্ত্রণ করি তায়
পৃথক্ পৃথক্ জনে জনে ॥

śuna ṭhākurāṇi sītā baiṣṇaba āniye ethā
āmantraṇa kariyā yatane |
yebā gāya yebā bāya āmantraṇa kari tāya
pṛthak pṛthak jane jane ||

shuna thakurani sita — listen, mistress Sita; vaishnava aniye etha — let us bring Vaishnavas here; amantrana kariya yatane — inviting them with care; yeba gaya — whoever sings; yeba baya — whoever plays; amantrana kari taya — inviting them; prithak prithak jane jane — each one separately

4.3"Listen, mistress Sita: let us bring Vaishnavas here,
inviting them with care;
whoever sings, whoever plays — let us invite them all,
each one separately."

এত বলি গোরা রায় আজ্ঞা দিল সভাকায়
বৈষ্ণব করহ আমন্ত্রণ ।
খোল করতাল লৈয়া অগুরু চন্দন দিয়া
পূর্ণ-ঘট করহ স্থাপন ॥

eta bali gorā rāya ājñā dila sabhākāya
baiṣṇaba karaha āmantraṇa |
khola karatāla laiyā aguru candana diyā
pūrṇa-ghaṭa karaha sthāpana ||

eta bali — saying this; gora raya — Gora Raya; ajna dila sabhakaya — commanded everyone; vaishnava karaha amantrana — invite the Vaishnavas; khola karatala laiya — taking the khol and karatalas; aguru chandana diya — [anointing them] with aloe-wood and sandal; purna-ghata karaha sthapana — set up the full water-pot

4.4Saying this, Gora Raya commanded everyone:
"Invite the Vaishnavas;
